metadata.response_anchor_rule: Any significant interval-specific increased/decreased phosphosite, independent of functional polarity
metadata.response_unresolved_rule: Unknown or dual/feedback polarity with significant interval change

baseline.note: Detection at baseline does not imply EGF-responsive activation.

intervals.polarity_interpretation: Activating: increase=supporting, decrease=opposing; Inhibitory: increase=opposing, decrease=supporting; Unknown/dual=unresolved. Neutral/missing are not carried forward.
